description: oriiion STAFF ONLY. Tell the customer their account exists and give them a way in. ALWAYS ASK which channel they should be contacted on — there is no default, and if the answer is SMS you must also ask for their phone number, which the tool will refuse to proceed without. Sends a link to choose their own password, valid for 7 days; a password is never put in a message. Sends once per customer — pass resend to issue a new link, which stops the old one working.

email.description: The customer's email address — the account to send for

notifyVia.description: REQUIRED. Ask the person you are helping which channel the customer should be contacted on. Do not guess.

phoneNumber.description: REQUIRED when notifyVia is sms. The customer's mobile number, e.g. 070 123 45 67 or +46701234567.

resend.description: Send again to a customer who already got their login. Issues a new link and invalidates the previous one — only use it when someone asked.
